item.description: - New: shake windows out of tabs. On the window map, grab a group of tabs and shake it left and right. The tabs come apart and the windows go back on the strip side by side. Works with a mouse and a trackpad. - New: take one window out of a stack or a tab group. Drag it from the window map into a gap between other windows and it gets its own column. - The Classic map can now combine windows into tabs too: rest a dragged window over the middle of another one, and drop it when "Combine into tabs" shows up. - A tab group on the Classic map shows the icons of its tabs side by side, not only the active one. - Clearer full width: the tour and a one-time tip now show that ⌃⌥F makes a window full width and that it stays on the strip, so you can still move it with ⌃⌥⇧← / →. - New Check for Updates button in Settings › General. - Butterfly map: wing tiles get their app icons back after a window returns to the map, and a window that became a tab no longer leaves an extra tile behind.

- A window you resized by hand on your other display no longer snaps back to its old width when you move windows on the first display. - The wing sound is now off unless you turn it on, and Full Butterfly no longer turns it on. If you had it on, the update turns it off once. Turn it back on in the menu bar (Wing sound) or in Settings › General, right under Theme.

- Smoother Basic motion: window edges no longer shake when you jump several windows with the mouse wheel or a shortcut. Trackpad swipes work exactly as before. - The card that stands in for a window at the edge of your other display now fades out instead of flickering, and is a little lighter.
